business_summary: Myriad Genetics, Inc., a molecular diagnostics and precision medicine company, develops molecular tests. It offers molecular diagnostic tests for oncology, women's health, and pharmacogenomics. It provides MyRisk Hereditary Cancer test, a DNA sequencing test for hereditary cancers; BRACAnalysis CDx Germline Companion Diagnostic test, a DNA sequencing test for metastatic breast, ovarian, metastatic pancreatic, and metastatic prostate cancer with deleterious or suspected deleterious germline BRCA variants; and MyChoice CDx Companion Diagnostic, a tumor test that determines homologous recombination deficiency status in patients with ovarian cancer. It offers Prolaris Prostate Cancer Prognostic, an RNA expression tumor analysis for assessing the aggressiveness of prostate cancer; EndoPredict Breast Cancer Prognostic, an RNA expression test for assessing the aggressiveness of breast cancer; Precise Tumor Molecular Profile, a genomic profiling test; Prequel Prenatal Screen, a prenatal screening test to screen chromosomal disorders in a fetus; Foresight Carrier Screen, a prenatal test for future parents to assess risk of passing on recessive genetic condition to offspring; SneakPeek Early Gender DNA, a non-invasive blood test that predicts the fetus's gender; FirstGene; and GeneSight Psychotropic Mental Health Medication, a DNA genotyping test to aid psychotropic drug selection for depression, anxiety, attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder, and other mental health conditions. It has a license collaboration with Illumina, Inc.; University of Texas M.D. Anderson Cancer Center; Mayo Foundation for Medical Education and Research; Children's Medical Center in Boston; Institut Curie and INSERM; and Eurobio Scientific SA. The company has a strategic alliance with SOPHiA GENETICS SA to advance new prostate cancer-specific genomic instability score technology for oncology approaches with AstraZeneca. The company was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Salt Lake City, Utah.

BRACAnalytics CDx 생식계열 동반 진단 테스트, 유해하거나 의심되는 유해한 생식계열 BRCA 변이가 있는 전이성 유방암, 난소암, 전이성 췌장암, 전이성 전립선암에 대한 DNA 시퀀싱 테스트. 및 난소암 환자의 상동 재조합 결핍 상태를 결정하는 종양 검사인 MyChoice CDx Companion Diagnostic이 있습니다. 전립선암의 공격성을 평가하기 위한 RNA 발현 종양 분석인 Prolaris Prostate Cancer Prognostic을 제공합니다. 유방암의 공격성을 평가하기 위한 RNA 발현 검사인 EndoPredict Breast Cancer Prognostic; 게놈 프로파일링 테스트인 정밀 종양 분자 프로파일(Precise Tumor Molecular Profile) Prequel Prenatal Screen은 태아의 염색체 장애를 선별하기 위한 산전 선별 검사입니다. 미래의 부모가 열성 유전 질환을 자손에게 물려줄 위험을 평가하기 위한 산전 검사인 Foresight Carrier Screen; SneakPeek 조기
